page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each of the 64 vCPUs maps to a dedicated physical core, ensuring consistent compute performance without resource sharing.

The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This memory density makes the instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Given its high memory allocation and dedicated CPU resources, the ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for enterprise databases, in-memory caching, large-scale data processing, and memory-heavy enterprise applications. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs represents a tradeoff, positioning this instance specifically for workloads that rely on external storage architectures and CPU-bound, memory-heavy processing.
